name: DIWALI
subtitle: Festival of Lights
description: Celebration of the victory of light over darkness and good over evil with clay lamps, fireworks, and family feasts.

name: HOLI
subtitle: Festival of Colors
description: The joyful arrival of spring celebrated with vibrant organic colored powders, music, and community revelry.

name: BAISAKHI
subtitle: Harvest & Khalsa Festival
description: The auspicious spring harvest festival marking the founding of the Khalsa Panth with spirited Bhangra and Gurdwaras.

name: GANESH CHATURTHI
subtitle: Grand Celebration of Lord Ganesha
description: A 10-day grand festival honoring Lord Ganesha with elaborate pandals, Dhol-Tasha beats, and majestic immersion processions.
